senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of אוס, √או; cmp. אוץ, אנץ, חוס; as to meaning cmp. כוף, אנן &c.)to bend, force; to do violence; to outrage &c.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 45a:12">Ḥull. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ בסימנים</he> if one in cutting presses the windpipe and gullet out of their natural position.
<cite ref="Chullin 45a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>אָנְסָה עצמה</he> if the animal strained its neck so as to dislocate the organs.
<cite ref="Gittin 44b">Gitt. 44ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 131a:2">Ḥull. 131ᵃ</cite> <he>הרי שאָנְסוּ וכ׳</he> if royal officers took forcible possession of (seized,) his barn.
Keth. III, 4 האוֹנֵס he who violates a woman. Part. pass. f. אֲנוּסָה an outraged woman. Y. Yeb. VI, 7ᶜ; a. fr.—Masc. אָנוּס the victim of an accident, unavoidably prevented.
<cite ref="Nedarim 27a">Ned. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ רחמנא וכ׳</he> the Merciful (the Law) acquits from responsibility him who is the victim of an unavoidable accident; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:7">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>לאַנְּסָהּ</he> to violate her.

senses.gloss: to be forced, overcome, to meet with an accident.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 31a">Ḥull. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>נֶאֶנְסָה וטבלה</he> if she dipped in the water by an accident <cite ref="Chullin 45a:11">Ib. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא תֵּאָנֵס</he> provided the animal is not forced so that its organs be dislocated.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:10">Keth. I, 10</cite> <he>נאנסה</he> she was outraged; a. v. fr.
